41211925.source: VESALIUS-CV (PMID 41211925) abstract: A total of 12,257 patients were randomly assigned to receive evolocumab (6129 patients) or placebo (6128) and were included in the efficacy analyses. A 3-point MACE event occurred in 336 patients (5-year Kaplan-Meier estimate, 6.2%) in the evolocumab group, as compared with 443 (8.0%) in the placebo group (hazard ratio, 0.75; 95% confidence interval [CI], 0.65 to 0.86; P<0.001). A 4-point MACE event occurred in 747 patients (5-year Kaplan-Meier estimate, 13.4%) in the evolocumab group, as compared with 907 (16.2%) in the placebo group (hazard ratio, 0.81; 95% CI, 0.73 to 0.89; P<0.001).
